faq.q: What is the origin of Yasmeen?
faq.a: Yasmeen is associated with Arabic. Yasmeen is Arabic يَاسْمِين (Yāsmīn), the word for the jasmine flower.
Yes — the underlying form يَاسْمِين is Arabic.
Yasmeen can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Yasmeen should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Yāsmīn is not a Quranic personal name.
